newsitem.title: USA: Northstar Health in forebearance deal.
newsitem.headline: Northstar Health in forebearance deal.

text.p: Northstar Health Services Inc said Tuesday it entered into an forbearance agreement with its senior lender and largest creditor, IBJ Schroder Bank & Trust Co.

Chief executive Thomas Zaucha said in an interview the bank agreed not to enforce its rights under the current $15 million credit agreement, on which the company has been in default since early 1996, until August 31.
"This puts everything on hold between us and the bank in the light of our default," Zaucha said.
He added the company anticipates the bank will extend the forebearance agreement beyond August 31. The company said the bank waived its right to default interest during the default period.
"With this agreement, Northstar has taken an important step toward normalization of its financial affairs," Zaucha said in an earlier statement.
Northstar's stock traded unchnaged at 2-1/8 Tuesday afternoon.
